title: The Craftable Series (former craftable totem of undying)
description: This project adds recipes that should be in Vanilla
body:
# The Craftable Series ![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24128a2b8c466abb9172a1ea555693cc0467220d.webp) ## Production **Provided by:** J0T0S0
**Loaders:** Neoforge, Fabric, Forge (usually unsupported)
## Overview **The Craftable Series** is a mod focused on adding crafting recipes for useful items that feel like they should already exist in the vanilla game. Minecraft has many rare, powerful, or hard-to-obtain items that are useful in survival gameplay, but some of them can only be found through exploration, mob drops, or specific structures. This mod aims to make those items more accessible by introducing balanced crafting recipes that fit naturally into the vanilla Minecraft experience. Whether you want to craft an **Enchanted Golden Apple**, obtain a **Totem of Undying** without relying only on raids or woodland mansions, or make items like **Tridents** and **Cobwebs** more practical to obtain, this mod gives players more control over their progression while keeping the gameplay feeling familiar. ## Content The mod currently adds new crafting recipes for the following items: - **Enchanted Golden Apple** - **Totem Of Undying** - **Trident** - **Cobweb** ## Join the community Join our official Discord server to stay updated on our products! --- ## Need A Server?
